servinfo.title: Water Pump Drive Belt Removal and Installation

s1.ptxt: Hoist vehicle and remove right side front wheel.
Remove engine undercover and right side engine under side cover.
Insert a clean cloth (1) between water pump drive belt (2) and water pump pulley (3) as shown.
While pulling the cloth in arrow direction, turn crankshaft pulley clockwise to disengage belt from pulley, and remove it.
Install water pump drive belt (1) according to the following procedure.

s2.ptxt: Fit ribs of water pump drive belt into grooves of crankshaft pulley (2).
Force water pump drive belt to water pump pulley by hand as shown in figure.
While keeping condition of Step b), turn crankshaft pulley clockwise using a wrench (3) and gradually install water pump drive belt to water pump pulley.
Turn crankshaft pulley clockwise until water pump drive belt is completely installed to water pump pulley.
Turn crankshaft pulley clockwise 720° and check that all ribs of belt fit into grooves of pulleys.

s1.ptxt: Check water pump drive belt tension.
Install engine undercover and right side engine under side cover.
